name: Creativehone History
author: Tosisoft

sections.description:
Creativehone History adds a custom Elementor widget to easily search and display creative history content without any coding.

Key Features:
* Custom Elementor widget named Creativehone History
* Search and display history content dynamically
* Works with Elementor Free and Elementor Pro
* Optimized for performance and easy to configure
* Compatible with the latest WordPress version (6.8)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the creativehone-history.zip file via the WordPress admin dashboard (Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin).
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor (Free or Pro) is installed and active.
  4. Open Elementor editor.
  5. Drag and drop the Creativehone History widget onto your page.
  6. Configure its settings and display creative history content.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. Creativehone History works with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro.

What is the minimum WordPress version required?

WordPress 5.2 or higher.

What PHP version is required?

This plugin requires PHP 7.2 or higher.

Will this plugin slow down my site?

No. Creativehone History is lightweight and optimized for performance.

Where can I get support?

For documentation, updates, and support, please visit the official plugin page:
https://github.com/tosisoft/Creativehone-History
or the Tosisoft website:
https://tosisoft.com/creativehone-history/
